answer: Persistent Query Residency Test. Each agent identity must hold a live, rate-limited query stream to a public data inlet, answering random challenges drawn from recent stream state. Identity rank rises only after a cumulative hours-of-verified-response summit; below it, actions are capped. An attacker running N sybils must staff N concurrent attention streams — real compute and human oversight per identity — making sustained fakery cost more than the rewards it farms. A shared grove of proxy answers gets detected by challenge divergence.
